as_of: Sep 10 2026 06:35 PT / 13:35 UTC — Intraday. US session lower on oil-led inflation shock: Brent tops $105 (last seen ~July), WTI above $100, US 10Y yield tops 4.9% (highest since 2023) after hot PPI (+0.4% m/m). Europe lower (DAX -0.6%), Asia mixed (KOSPI -0.25%, Nikkei +0.2%, HSI -1.27%). Crypto risk-off: BTC ~$76.9k (-3.4%), ETH ~$2,418 (-3.8%).

indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: US intraday Thu Sep 10: S&P ~7,592, -0.57% from Wed close 7,636.36. Third straight down session as Brent tops $105 and the 10Y tops 4.9% (highest since 2023) following PPI +0.4%. Energy bid, broad multiples pressured by rates.

indices.name: 道琼斯
indices.note: Dow ~52,077 intraday, -0.58% from Wed close 52,380.66. Rate-sensitive and industrial names weighed by the oil-shock inflation narrative and rising yields.

indices.name: 纳斯达克
indices.note: Nasdaq ~26,026 intraday, -0.86% — the weakest of the big three as yields near two-decade highs pressure long-duration tech/AI. BofA argues rising yields aren't yet a threat to the AI trade.

indices.name: 恒生指数
indices.note: HSI closed 24,954.47, -1.27% Thu Sep 10 — tracking the global risk-off and oil spike; H-share tech the relative laggard.

indices.name: 日经225
indices.note: Nikkei 225 65,270.95, +0.20% — resilient despite the global risk-off; yen and JGB long-end (20Y ~3.7%+) remain the cross-market watch items.

indices.name: KOSPI
indices.note: KOSPI 7,033.92, -0.25% Thu Sep 10 — holding above 7,000 after a strong multi-week rally; still Asia's key risk gauge into the tech/oil backdrop.

indices.name: 台湾加权
indices.note: TSEC weighted 46,940.49, -0.51% — semis soft as US tech leads the downside.

indices.name: 英国富时100
indices.note: FTSE 100 10,629.46, -0.38% — energy strength on crude partly offsets the broad risk-off.

indices.name: 德国DAX
indices.note: DAX 25,423.82, -0.60% — autos and rate-sensitive names lead losses amid EU tariff/trade friction.

indices.name: 法国CAC40
indices.note: CAC 40 8,126.94, -0.36% — luxury/autos soft; German 10Y issuance at 2010-high yields adds duration pressure.

crypto.name: Bitcoin (BTC)
crypto.note: BTC ~$76,900 (-3.4% 24h, OKX/CoinGecko). Risk-off drag from rising real yields and the oil/inflation shock; 24h low ~$76.7k.

crypto.name: Ethereum (ETH)
crypto.note: ETH ~$2,418 (-3.84% 24h), held near $2.5k support; CPI on Friday is the next catalyst for a range break ($2,431–$2,600).

brent_crude.note: CRITICAL — Brent ~$105.23 (+3.97%), back above $100 (last seen ~July) and the single largest cross-market driver, on US-Iran escalation and Saudi output cuts amid Houthi threats.

wti_crude.note: WTI ~$100.02 (+4.13%), topping the psychological $100 mark — supply-risk premium from US-Iran tanker strikes persists.

gold.note: COMEX gold ~$4,395 (-0.46%), softer as rising real yields and a firm dollar offset the safe-haven bid. Still elevated on US-EU trust erosion.

us_10y_yield.note: US 10Y ~4.92%, ABOVE 4.9% — highest since 2023 — as the oil surge stokes inflation/hike fears and Bessent's $6bn buyback plan disappointed investors.

macro.oil_iran_escalation: CRITICAL: US-Iran conflict persists — US crude back above $100 for the first time since May as the market braces for a prolonged Iran war. Saudi Arabia cut output to its lowest this year on Houthi threats. Oil is the dominant global driver.
macro.ppi_hot: US PPI rose 0.4% m/m in August, as expected — but combined with oil >$100 it hardens the inflation narrative and stokes Fed-hike bets. CPI Friday is the key macro print.
macro.us_10y_4p9: US 10Y yield tops 4.9%, the highest since 2023, as the oil surge raises inflation fears. Bloomberg: 'US bond yields extend climb as oil advance stokes rate-hike bets.' FT: 'Treasury yields jump as Bessent's $6bn buyback plan disappoints investors.'
macro.fed_hike_bets: Traders boosted Fed-hike bets (Bloomberg Markets Wrap: 'Stocks, Bonds Fall as Traders Boost Fed-Hike Bets'). Hawkish repricing driven by oil-led inflation + a hot-ish PPI.
macro.us_futures: US equity futures extended their drop after the PPI data as oil prices and yields spiked (Bloomberg). Risk-off tone dominates the session.
macro.asia_close: Asia Thu Sep 10: Nikkei +0.20% (65,271), KOSPI -0.25% (7,034, holding >7,000), TSEC -0.51%, HSI -1.27% (24,954). Broadly defensive on oil/rates.
macro.crypto_riskoff: Crypto tracking the broader risk-asset softness: BTC -3.4% (~$76.9k), ETH -3.84% (~$2,418). Nasdaq investing $100M in Kraken parent Payward for tokenized stocks — a structural adoption note.
macro.commodities_metals: Copper and FCX plunged on a tariff report and surging yields; silver and gold also fell (Yahoo). Precious/base metals pressured by rising real yields despite the risk-off.
macro.watch: Key watch items: 1) Brent >$105 & US-Iran escalation ('prolonged war' framing); 2) US 10Y >4.9% (highest since 2023) & Fed-hike repricing; 3) Friday CPI; 4) KOSPI holding >7,000; 5) crypto -3–4% risk-off; 6) Apple iPhone cadence/AI-trade commentary.

headlines.title: U.S. crude oil tops $100 again – last seen in May – as market braces for prolonged Iran war
headlines.summary: Oil is the dominant cross-market driver; Brent >$105 and WTI >$100 revive the inflation shock and pressure equities and bonds.

headlines.title: 10-year Treasury yield tops 4.9%, highest since 2023, as oil surge raises inflation fears
headlines.summary: The 10Y breaking 4.9% is the key valuation headwind; rising yields cap equity multiples and lift Fed-hike expectations.

headlines.title: Stocks, Bonds Fall as Traders Boost Fed-Hike Bets: Markets Wrap
headlines.summary: Stocks and bonds sold off together as oil-driven inflation fears pushed traders to price a higher Fed path.

headlines.title: Treasury yields jump as Bessent's $6bn buyback plan disappoints investors
headlines.summary: US Treasury buyback disappointment added to the long-end selloff — yields pushed higher across the curve.

headlines.title: Wholesale prices rose 0.4% in August, as expected
headlines.summary: PPI +0.4% m/m as expected, but with oil >$100 it reinforces the inflation narrative ahead of Friday's CPI.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia cuts oil output to lowest this year on Houthi threats
headlines.summary: Fresh supply-side tightening in the Middle East underpins the crude spike above $100.

headlines.title: Copper, FCX stock plunge on tariff report, surging yields; silver, gold also fall
headlines.summary: Metals hit by rising real yields and tariff headlines — copper/FCX sharply lower despite the risk-off backdrop.

headlines.title: Bank of America says rising bond yields aren't a threat to AI trade yet
headlines.summary: BofA pushes back on the yields-vs-AI-trade bear case, though Nasdaq is the weakest major US index intraday (-0.86%).
